response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT sc.powerstatus, sc.count, sc.count * 1.0 / tc.total AS share FROM status_counts sc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_val FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.count, s.share FROM shares s, avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_val) SELECT SUM(count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share) AS above_average_offset FROM above_avg
